name: GROMACS GUI v4.3.0 - ALL-IN-ONE Package
body:
## GROMACS GUI v4.3.0 - ALL-IN-ONE RELEASE (RECOMMENDED)

This is the ALL-IN-ONE package with GUI + GROMACS engine bundled together.

After downloading, just extract and double-click **start.bat** to run. No separate GROMACS installation needed!

### Package Contents
- GROMACS_GUI_v4.3.0.exe - Main GUI executable (90 MB)
- Python 3.13 - Bundled Python runtime
- PyQt5 - GUI framework
- GROMACS 2026.x - Full GROMACS engine (1.6 GB)
- CUDA 13.0 DLLs - GPU acceleration (optional)
- start.bat - One-click launch script
- uninstall.bat - Clean removal script

### System Requirements
- OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
- RAM: 8 GB minimum
- Disk: 3 GB free space
- GPU: NVIDIA + CUDA 13.0+ (OPTIONAL)

### Quick Start
1. Download GROMACS_GUI_v4.3.0_Full_Package.zip (1.37 GB)
2. Extract to any folder
3. Double-click start.bat - DONE!

### No GPU? No Problem!
- With GPU: GPU auto-enabled
- Without GPU: Auto CPU mode, all features work
